explanation: A skin disease described in the Bible as a form of impurity that can lead to isolation from society.
The supreme religious leader in Israel, responsible for performing ceremonies and sacrifices on behalf of the people.
Red spots or swellings on the skin that may be a symptom of an illness, in this case leprosy.
When something is completely surrounded or shut in; here used to describe hair growing around an area with a rash.
In a religious context, it means being free from sin, impurity, or disease, and thus acceptable to God and society.
The opposite of clean; in this context, it refers to a person infected with leprosy and therefore unable to participate in religious or social activities.
Keeping away from other people, either voluntarily or due to illness. In Leviticus 13, those suffering from leprosy are required to live in isolation.
